recordsite.title: Site
recordsite.remarks: The site of the event record.

eventdtl1.title: Event Detail 1
eventdtl1.remarks: Information from the event record that further defines the event. For example, a component positioning event may include the requirement to independently verify the new component position.

recordrev.title: Revision
recordrev.remarks: The revision of the event record at the time that the event occurred.

recordkey.title: Event Record
recordkey.remarks: Identifies the record that was used to specify and manage the event.

recordtype.title: Record Type
recordtype.remarks: The type of record that was used to specify and manage the event. For example, a lineup or clearance record can be used to specify and manage component positioning events. A duty station shift record can be used to report a new component condition or position.

event.title: Event
event.remarks: A change in state of an operational location. For example, the position of a location might be changed during lineup or clearance activity, or a new condition might be reported during duty station shift activity. Events of this kind are tracked centrally on the location record and constitute the operational history.

pluslocophistid.title: Unique ID
pluslocophistid.remarks: Unique ID of the operational history event.

recorddate.title: Date Created
recorddate.remarks: The date on which the event record was created.

eventdate.title: Event Date
eventdate.remarks: The date on which the event occurred.

orgid.title: Organization
orgid.remarks: The organization to which the location belongs.

eventstate.title: Event Status
eventstate.remarks: Indicates whether the event is complete, in progress, or incomplete. Only events that are complete can be reused by other applications. For example, a component positioning event that is complete on one lineup can be reused to position the same component by credit on another lineup. Similarly, only events that are complete can be reliably factored into decision-making processes.

recorddtl2.title: Record Detail 2
recorddtl2.remarks: Information from the event record that further defines the source of the event. For example, this detail may specify the lineup group or clearance tag with which the event is associated.

recorddtl1.title: Record Detail 1
recorddtl1.remarks: Information from the event record that further defines the source of the event.

location.title: Location
location.remarks: Identifies the location to which this event applies.

recorddtl3.title: Record Detail 3
recorddtl3.remarks: Information from the event record that defines the event. For example, for clearance-related positioning events, this detail indicates whether the event occurred during application or restoration.
